query: SELECT t.path FROM tools t JOIN endpoints e ON e.id=$1 LEFT JOIN tool_policies p ON p.source_id=t.source_id AND p.upstream_name=t.upstream_name AND p.endpoint_id=e.id WHERE p.action='block' OR (NOT e.all_tools AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM endpoint_tools scope WHERE scope.endpoint_id=e.id AND scope.source_id=t.source_id AND scope.upstream_name=t.upstream_name))
